body: If you need workaround for now, you can use `ng-if` to remove the transclude when it's empty
One problem that this bug has highlighted to me is that we are currently testing ngUpgrade against 1.5.x (which doesn't expose this problem) rather than 1.6.0.
I think we need to do a better job of creating our bound transclusion function, so that it has a suitable transclusion scope passed through.
Working on a fix for this.

There are some issues with your plnkr. Here is an [updated version][1]. This still doesn't work (because of an ngUpgrade bug), but should by fixed by #16627.

[1]: https://plnkr.co/edit/fFncmfxKiKgS1IUu01H6?p=preview

Actually, you can see that simple transclusion works already: [updated plnkr][1]
What doesn't work (and will be fixed by #16627) is:
- Fallback content.
- Multi-slot transclusion.

[1]: https://plnkr.co/edit/e6LtTIvMzKxLFZ4PuruA?p=preview
